payload.entry:
LAND AUDIT / REMAINING-WORK TALE: Read the epic and every note on all four closed children; reviewed plugin commits da5cdda/a57994a/6050124/a572162, actual transport/session/card/entrypoint/YAML/harness code, Rust writer contracts, and both approved plans. Final decisions remain per-gesture commits, mobile degrade, album-only overloaded chord, and no memory edits. No epic closure is justified yet.

Reproduced epic defects in existing fixture/model code: Alt+j selects the next field with draftOps=[]; input edit plus 350ms yields previews=0; a report repaint resets typed New draft to original One; Undo after fp1->fp2 then external rebase previews with external-fp3 instead of preserved fp2. Source audit also found stale initial-choice row/action indices after deletion, missing asynchronous YAML-Done excursion identity checks, bullet-only fallback that also accepts record-parent resolution, and unrun CDP steps using detached controls / select-only clicks / no real two-pane delayed save / a missing ledgerEval return. These are remaining epic work, not new task beads.

Integration: primary b7f74b58 includes b04120b0 singular report support and b7f74b58 retired-record-fixture repair; intervening Gmail/gcal changes have no schema transport overlap. Plugin non-epic walker/footer, Command Mode Tab, catalog singular, and docs commits reviewed. Fetched base, incorporated 3ef045b and later b6f3dd9. Those fix stale walkMode tests, reference budget, task-tag baseline test, ancestry warnings, and duplicate headers. Remaining integration: header/Card still displays 1 tv_show despite report singular=TV show; plan consumes additive singular using existing catalog fallback. Existing 58 focused editor tests passed. On 3ef045b, baseline controls were 72/73 (task-tag failed; file:explicit:5b5c41bf3b75a57541e9c4e2); after b6f3dd9, task-tag/bracket-repeat/period-links/album-header passed 98/98. Latest plugin inventory: 11 synced, 0 drift. Read b6f3dd9 rollout artifact file:explicit:1e158a38d48049a8df1636ba: real startup smoke passed on Athena using deployed bytes; its earlier 45-check album/header walk does NOT prove the later Schema Card flow. No Obsidian/xvfb on Apollo. just check has not run in this audit; completion tale owns it. check-full was not run. epic-symbols for kr.4.1 and parent phase kr.4 are empty; no primary symvision recipe.

FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (all phase proposals):
- .1 #1, .2 #1, .3 #1, .4 #1 task-tag failure: duplicate bob-cli-kw; recorded independent fail and subsequently verified b6f3dd9 fix there. No new task/+1 against a repaired node.
- Same notes, named timing failures: corroborating phase evidence recorded on bob-cli-km (event-link-times), bob-cli-io (frees-marks), bob-cli-ki (keep-moving surface). Do not route these to generic bob-cli-f8. No new task. No fresh full-suite timing reproduction/frequency claimed; unspecified extra perf failure lacks a node and cannot justify a distinct task.
- .1 #1 reduced-motion 90s timeout: existing bob-cli-fz lead recorded there without new +1 because no retained phase trace proves the browser cause. No distinct task justified.
- .1 #2 mount collision: bob-cli-it, same current source condition independently verified; recorded phase corroboration there. Later phases got past mount preparation; no new task.
- .2 #2, .3 #2, .4 #2 lychee/Event notes: duplicate bob-cli-l7; corroborated current source with +1 and proposing bead IDs. Existing kk covers different anchors.
- .3 #1 and .4 #1 walkMode v2 assertions: declined as new follow-up, fixed by 3ef045b; current 98/98 control includes these nodes.
- .4 #2 navigation docs budget: declined as a new/pre-existing-task report. Measurement shows 5903 words at a57994a -> 6039 at this epic's 6050124, so the epic contributed the overage. 3ef045b fixes it (5977), b6f3dd9 preserves further trimming. Do not reopen historical bob-cli-jz.
- .1 #3 and .4 #3 real Obsidian missing (also .2 verification note #3): declined as out-of-scope follow-up; required acceptance remains this epic's work and is explicit in the tale.
- .3 #3 partial deploy: superseded by latest 11 synced / 0 drift and b6f3dd9 rollout evidence; final changed tree still requires its own deployment/smoke.
No new tasks created after duplicate search, last-week task sweep, and active-epic review. Unrelated established tasks retain their ownership. Tale sase_plan_album_schema_card_landing.md is medium, only remaining work, and must finish this epic's symbol cleanup, normal close, symvision if available, linked plan status done, then normal close of parent PHASE bob-cli-kr.4. It must leave outer epic bob-cli-kr to its waiting lander, never force success or wait for its own future commit/CI before closeout.
